steamify.options.title: Contraption Riggin'
steamify.haptic.mining.tooltip: A faint tick at each crack stage while breakin' a block
steamify.haptic.fishing.tooltip: A buzz th' moment a fish takes th' bait
steamify.haptic.explosion.tooltip: Rumble from nearby explosions, stronger th' closer they be
steamify.haptic.thunder.tooltip: Rumble when lightnin' strikes, stronger th' closer it be
steamify.haptic.bow.tooltip: Ticks that quicken as a bow draws an' a tap at full draw. Also clicks when a crossbow loads or a trident be ready
steamify.haptic.shield.tooltip: A thud when yer shield stops a hit
steamify.haptic.heartbeat.tooltip: A heartbeat at 3 hearts an' below, faster th' lower ye go
steamify.haptic.trigger.tooltip: Pullin' a trigger past its tap point
steamify.haptic.rightPad.tooltip: Light ticks while yer thumb moves on th' right compass pad
steamify.haptic.hotbar.tooltip: A tick each time th' left compass pad picks a fresh belt o' cutlasses slot
steamify.haptic.footsteps.tooltip: Each step on th' ground, alternatin' left an' right
steamify.haptic.damage.tooltip: Takin' damage, harder th' bigger th' hit
steamify.haptic.landing.tooltip: Hittin' th' ground after a fall, stronger th' further ye fell
steamify.haptic.flight.tooltip: Low wind rumble while glidin' or flyin', pulsin' faster th' faster ye go
steamify.haptic.falling.tooltip: Sharp rattle while fallin', faster th' faster ye fall
steamify.calibrate.title: Calibrate Sextant
steamify.calibrate.hint: Put th' contraption down on a flat surface an' don't touch it
steamify.calibrate.waiting: Waitin' fer th' contraption t' be still...
steamify.calibrate.done: Arr! Th' sextant be true now
steamify.calibrate.noGyro: Nay contraption with a sextant connected
steamify.calibrate.button.tooltip: Measures th' sextant's restin' drift with th' contraption lyin' still. Redo it if aimin' drifts or slow turns feel off
steamify.calibrate.prompt.title: True yer sextant, sailor?
steamify.calibrate.prompt: Sextant aimin' feels best once th' contraption has been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with th' contraption lyin' on a flat surface.
steamify.options.sets.tooltip: Extra layers o' contraption knots, switched on by a button, a grip, a tiller touch or a tiller pushed t' its edge
steamify.sets.title: Action Crews
steamify.sets.add.tooltip: A layer o' knots on top o' th' normal ones. It only changes th' knots ye crew in it
steamify.sets.name: Name
steamify.sets.trigger.tooltip: Tap, then press th' button or combo, touch a grip or tiller, or push a tiller t' its edge. Already holdin' a grip? Let go an' touch it again. Hold B fer a second t' cancel. Right-tap (or LT) t' pick from a list
steamify.sets.enter.tooltip: Pressed once when th' crew switches on
steamify.sets.enter.title: %s: On Enter
steamify.sets.exit.tooltip: Pressed once when th' crew switches off
steamify.sets.exit.title: %s: On Exit
steamify.sets.hold.tooltip: Held down th' whole time th' crew be on, an' let go when it switches off. E.g. a zoom key, on a crew triggered by R5
steamify.sets.hold.title: %s: Hold While On
steamify.sets.mode.tooltip: Hold: on while th' trigger be held. Toggle: each press switches it. While Released: on while th' trigger be NOT held, e.g. lettin' go o' a grip
steamify.sets.where.tooltip: In Captain's Logs: th' crew's knots work on captain's log screens like th' inventory, o'er th' normal captain's log controls on th' buttons they use. Handy fer a mod's inventory keys
steamify.sets.places.tooltip: Tap while in a singleplayer sea or on a port t' add it, again t' remove it. From th' title spyglass view: clear. With seas crew, th' crew be only on there. With nay trigger or booty, it's always on there
steamify.sets.gyro.tooltip: Sextant while this crew be on. Unchanged leaves it t' th' crews below, normally on while th' right pad be touched
steamify.battery.low.title: Yer powder keg be runnin' low
steamify.battery.low: %s%% left. Plug 'er in afore she sinks
steamify.sets.items.tooltip: Tap while holdin' an plunder t' add it, again t' remove it. With an empty hand: clear. With booty crew, th' crew be only on while ye hold one o' them (an' its button trigger, if it has one, be active)
steamify.sets.tunes.tooltip: Tiller, pad an' sextant speed, deadzone, Steady Aim an' aim assist while this crew be on
steamify.sets.tunes.title: %s: Jumpiness
steamify.sets.tunes.slider.tooltip: All th' way left: unchanged, th' normal Contraption Riggin' value applies
steamify.sets.binds.tooltip: Controls spyglass view fer this crew. Grey knots come from th' normal layout. Escape t' unbind in this crew, Backspace t' go back t' th' normal knot
steamify.sets.editing: Editin' action crew: %s  (Escape t' unbind, Backspace t' use th' normal knot)
steamify.options.hotbar: Left Compass Pad Belt o' Cutlasses
steamify.option.hotbar.strip.tooltip: OFF: a 3x3 grid in th' middle o' th' spyglass view, slots 1-3 on th' top row. ON: th' pad's width maps t' th' belt o' cutlasses, left edge slot 1, right edge slot 9
steamify.option.hotbar.gridSpot.tooltip: Center: th' grid pops up while th' left pad be touched. A corner: th' grid stays there in place o' th' normal belt o' cutlasses. Not used with Strip Layout
steamify.debug.title: Debug Shortcuts
steamify.option.look.stickSpeed.tooltip: How fast th' right tiller turns th' camera
steamify.option.look.padSpeed.tooltip: How far th' camera turns per swipe on th' right compass pad
steamify.option.look.gyro.tooltip: Camera rotation per contraption rotation. 1.0x turns th' camera exactly as far as ye turn th' contraption
steamify.option.look.stickDeadzone.toolt: How far a tiller must move before it counts. Raise it if th' camera or sailor drifts on its own
steamify.option.menu.cursorSpeed.tooltip: How fast th' right tiller an' compass pad move th' cursor in captain's logs
steamify.option.look.invertY.tooltip: Flips up an' down fer tiller, compass pad an' sextant camera control
steamify.option.gyro.steadyAim.tooltip: Lowers sextant jumpiness while drawin' a bow, chargin' a crossbow, readyin' a trident, usin' a spyglass or holdin' a loaded crossbow
How much Steady Aim lowers sextant jumpiness
steamify.option.aim.assist.tooltip: Slows turnin' while yer crosshair be on a scallywag in reach an' gently pulls toward it while ye steer. Contraption only, never affects th' mouse
steamify.option.aim.assistStrength.toolt: How strongly aim assist slows an' pulls
steamify.option.aim.assistSingleplayerOn: Turns aim assist off on ports an' LAN seas
steamify.onboard.title: Steamify Shore Leave
steamify.onboard.page1: This can be changed later in riggin'
steamify.onboard.page2: Sextant aimin' feels best once th' contraption has been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with th' contraption lyin' on a flat surface.
steamify.onboard.gyro.none: This contraption has nay sextant, so there's nothin' t' calibrate
steamify.option.haptics.master.tooltip: Scales every haptic effect at once. Th' individual sliders below crew each effect relative t' this
steamify.onboard.page3: Try th' right tiller, th' right compass pad, an' th' sextant while yer thumb rests on th' compass pad
steamify.onboard.page4: Which layouts should th' on-spyglass view quill board switch between?
steamify.bind.tooltip: Tap, then press a button or combo, push a tiller t' its edge or swipe a compass pad. Right-tap (or LT) t' pick long press, double press an' other press types
steamify.bind.title: %s: Contraption Knots
steamify.bind.combo.tooltip: Tap, then press th' fresh button or combo, push a tiller t' its edge or swipe a compass pad. Right-tap (or LT) t' pick from a list. Escape t' remove this knot
steamify.gesture.regular.tooltip: On fer as long as ye hold th' buttons
steamify.gesture.short.tooltip: Taps when ye let go before th' long press time. Pair it with a Long Press on th' same buttons t' give them two actions
steamify.gesture.long.tooltip: Turns on once ye've held fer th' long press time, an' stays on until ye let go
steamify.gesture.double.tooltip: Turns on with a quick second press an' stays on while ye hold it. A Short Press on th' same buttons waits out th' double press time first
steamify.gesture.start.tooltip: Taps th' moment ye press, even when th' same buttons also have a long or double press
steamify.gesture.release.tooltip: Taps when ye let go, however long ye held
steamify.option.binds.longPress.tooltip: How long t' hold fer a Long Press. Lettin' go sooner counts as a Short Press
steamify.option.binds.doublePress.toolti: How soon th' second press o' a Double Press has t' come
steamify.option.binds.stickEdge.tooltip: How far a tiller has t' be pushed fer its edge inputs (L Stick Up, L Stick Edge...), from th' center (0%%) t' all th' way (100%%)
steamify.option.binds.padEdge.tooltip: How far from th' center yer finger has t' be fer a compass pad's edge inputs (L Pad Up, L Pad Edge...)
steamify.option.binds.swipeStep.tooltip: How far yer finger travels per press o' a swipe input (L Pad Swipe Up...), in percent o' th' pad's width. Lower scrolls faster
steamify.steam.toast.body: Ye'll get double orders. Sink Steam.
steamify.steam.warning: Steam be sailin': its contraption riggin' may double yer orders
steamify.steam.warning.fix: Scuttle Steam while ye sail with Steamify
steamify.picker.hint: Pick one, or several t' hold together
steamify.profiles.title: Flags
steamify.profiles.button.tooltip: Whole setups t' switch between with one tap: knots, action crews an' these riggin'. Each contraption remembers th' flag ye last used with it an' switches back t' it when it connects. Sextant calibration be shared by all o' them
steamify.profiles.add.tooltip: Adds a plunder o' th' current flag t' th' list. Tap it t' switch t' it
steamify.option.look.padFriction.tooltip: How quickly a flick on th' right compass pad spins down. Higher stops sooner
steamify.share.invalid: Th' treasure chest doesn't hold anythin' copied from Steamify
steamify.profiles.copy.tooltip: Copies this flag t' th' treasure chest as one line o' text t' share. Sextant calibration isn't included, but sea names an' port addresses in its action crews be
steamify.profiles.paste.tooltip: Adds a flag from text copied with Plunder, an' switches t' it
steamify.sets.copy.tooltip: Copies this crew t' th' treasure chest as one line o' text t' share
steamify.sets.paste.tooltip: Adds a crew from text copied with Plunder Crew
steamify.profiles.name.tooltip: Name o' th' active flag (th' highlighted one)
steamify.profiles.lock.tooltip: Keeps th' contraption ye be usin' tied t' this flag. Switchin' flags still works, but th' contraption comes back t' this one th' next time ye pick it up
steamify.option.gyro.playerSpace.tooltip: ON: turnin' port an' starboard follows th' horizon however ye hold yer contraption. OFF: only twistin' it 'round its own mast turns
